meta.actor: Claude — consolidation pass (no research, no content rewriting)
meta.scope: Every Grok batch file for Syria merged into one file. Records are byte-faithful to the batches except for the normalisations listed in _consolidation.

reports.title: Population estimates
reports.description: Population estimates. Population is approximately 26–27 million inside the country; large-scale displacement (internal and external) remains a defining demographic feature.
reports._notes: Core demographic node. Population ~26–27 million; displacement is structural.
reports._url_evidence: UNFPA World Population Dashboard page for Syria; page shows 'Total Population (2025): 25,600,000' plus age-structure and demographic indicators.
reports._cadence_evidence: UNFPA World Population Dashboard country page; its technical notes state the indicators 'are updated annually', drawing on the UN Population Division's World Population Prospects (2024 revision). Current figure shown is 25.6m for 2025.

reports.title: National Accounts of Syria (GDP)
reports.description: National accounts and GDP estimates. The economy contracted catastrophically during the conflict; recovery remains partial and data quality is limited. External estimates are widely used for surveillance.
reports._notes: Primary macroeconomic output node under severe data constraints.
reports._url_evidence: UNSD (UN Statistics Division) country profile for the Syrian Arab Republic showing GDP in million current US$ (2015/2020/2025), GDP growth rate and GDP per capita, plus sectoral gross value added.
reports._cadence_evidence: data.un.org country profile is the UNdata application - '50+ statistical indicators for 229 countries/territories' - rendered as a live indicator table (values for 2015, 2020, 2025 with 2023/2024 estimates). No editions, no issue dates and no stated release cycle.
reports.cadence_note: Continuously updated database/portal with no discrete editions. The number is the renderer convention decided 2026-08-18 (HANDOFF section 7) and applied 2026-08-19: a nominal releases_per_year so that absence keeps meaning 'one-off instrument' only - 250 encodes business-day updating (the live corpus's daily-FX convention), 365 genuinely all-days monitoring. It is a statement of continuous flow for the pulse/beam system, not a claim of counted editions - the observed reality is in _cadence_evidence.

reports.title: Consumer Price Index and inflation statistics
reports.description: CPI and inflation rates. Inflation has been extremely elevated and volatile under currency collapse, supply disruption and monetary financing pressures.
reports._notes: Core high-frequency price node under extreme inflation conditions.
reports._url_evidence: Central Bank of Syria 'تقارير التضخم الشهرية' (Monthly Inflation Reports) list, with columns for M-o-M, Y-o-Y and CPI values; the series runs 2018 to August 2020 and has not been updated since.
reports._cadence_evidence: Central Bank of Syria page is headed 'تقارير التضخم الشهرية' (Monthly Inflation Reports) and tabulates one report per month with M-o-M, Y-o-Y and CPI: 12 editions in 2018, 12 in 2019 and 8 in 2020. Series is dormant - the last edition is August 2020.

reports.title: Balance of Payments and external accounts
reports.publisher: Central Bank of Syria / external estimates
reports.description: BOP and external-sector statistics where available. Formal trade and capital flows are limited; remittances, humanitarian inflows and informal channels dominate the external position.
reports._notes: External-accounts node under constrained formal data and large informal/humanitarian flows.
_referenced_by: Central Bank monetary and external analysis
reports._url_evidence: Central Bank of Syria 'إحصاءات ميزان المدفوعات' (Balance of Payments Statistics) category page, linking to current-account-balance and international-investment-position indicator series in million US$.
reports._cadence_evidence: CBS balance-of-payments landing page only offers four unlinked table headings (BOP indicators, international investment position, relative change in key BOP indicators, BOP indicators as % of GDP). No dates, no editions and no periodicity stated.

reports.title: Internal displacement and return statistics
reports.publisher: Derived from OCHA / UNHCR and monitoring sources
reports.description: Statistics on internal displacement and returns. An estimated 5.5 million IDPs remain displaced; returns have accelerated in some periods but large residual displacement persists. Continuously cited in every humanitarian and demographic assessment.
reports._url_evidence: OCHA's Syrian Arab Republic country page, stating some 7 million people internally displaced, over 4 million refugees, and around 1.9 million IDPs plus 900,000 refugees returned since December.
reports._cadence_evidence: OCHA Syria country page is a funding/needs landing hub. The only publication on it is an undated 'Briefing to the Security Council on the humanitarian situation in Syria'; there is no situation-report list, no flash-update cadence and no stated release frequency.

reports.title: Exchange-rate and Syrian pound statistics
reports.publisher: Central Bank of Syria / market monitoring
reports.description: Official and parallel-market exchange rates for the Syrian pound. The pound has depreciated massively from pre-war levels (tens of thousands per USD in recent parallel readings); the gap between official and market rates and extreme inflation are structural features.
reports._url_evidence: Central Bank of Syria 'النشرة الرسمية' (Official Exchange Rate Bulletin) archive, with dated bulletins running through 6 August 2026 and mid-rate values listed per publication date.
reports._cadence_evidence: CBS 'النشرة الرسمية' (Official Bulletin) of exchange rates: one downloadable bulletin per date, entries running continuously from 8 July 2026 to 18 August 2026 with gaps only on weekends, across a 125-page archive. Business-daily publication; this is the one CBS series still current.

reports.title: Wheat production and food-security statistics
reports.publisher: Derived from national and monitoring sources
reports.description: Statistics on wheat production. Output collapsed during conflict and drought years; recent seasons show recovery toward multi-million-ton levels in favourable rainfall years. Eastern governorates remain the main production base. Food security remains fragile.
reports._notes: Core food-security crop densification under recovery conditions.
reports._url_evidence: FAO GIEWS Country Brief for the Syrian Arab Republic (23 February 2026), giving 2025 cereal production of 1.2 million tonnes (over 60 percent below average) and 2025/26 wheat import requirements of 3 million tonnes.
reports._cadence_evidence: FAO GIEWS Country Brief for Syria shows 'Reference Date: 23-February-2026' and a current-issue PDF, plus an archive of Special Reports (1999, 2012, 2013, 2015-2019, 2021) and GIEWS Updates (2012, 2014, 2020) that is plainly irregular. The page states no update frequency for the country brief itself.

reports.title: Education disruption and out-of-school statistics
reports.publisher: Derived from UNICEF and education monitoring sources
reports.description: Statistics and framing of education access under conflict and recovery. Approximately 2.45 million children are out of school; thousands of schools remain non-functional. Continuously cited in humanitarian and human-capital analysis.
reports._notes: Core education densification under severe conflict disruption.
reports._url_evidence: UNICEF Syria education programme page, stating about 2 million children out of school and over 7,000 schools damaged or destroyed.
reports._cadence_evidence: UNICEF Syria education page is an evergreen thematic programme page, not a dated publication. Its Resources block links 'Response snapshots' covering 2025-2026 periods (e.g. 'January to December 2025') but the page states no publication schedule.

reports.title: Health access and nutrition statistics
reports.publisher: Derived from UNICEF / WHO and humanitarian sources
reports.description: Statistics on health-service access and malnutrition. Large shares of the population require nutrition support; hundreds of thousands of children under five are affected by life-threatening malnutrition. Health-system functionality remains severely constrained.
reports._notes: Core health and nutrition densification under humanitarian emergency conditions.
reports._url_evidence: WHO EMRO Syrian Arab Republic country page, showing the country health indicator set (population, maternal mortality ratio, primary health care centres per 10,000, life expectancy, health expenditure) and health-sector situation reports.
reports._cadence_evidence: WHO EMRO Syria country page is an institutional landing page. It alludes to 'Situation reports on north-west Syria' and health-sector 4Ws snapshots but gives no cadence; the newest dated items are news stories from 21 January 2020 and 17 December 2019, and the framework document is dated 2018.

reports.title: Electricity generation and capacity statistics
reports.publisher: Derived from Ministry of Electricity and monitoring sources
reports.description: Statistics on electricity production and available capacity. Generation remains far below pre-war levels; chronic shortfalls, fuel constraints and damaged infrastructure are structural features. Limited renewable contribution is emerging.
reports._notes: Core power-system statistical product under severe infrastructure damage.

reports.title: Fiscal balance and revenue statistics
reports.publisher: Derived from Ministry of Finance and IMF-aligned monitoring
reports.description: Fiscal revenue, expenditure and balance indicators under transitional conditions. Recent readings show very constrained absolute revenues and spending relative to pre-war levels; customs and limited hydrocarbon receipts feature among available sources. Budget planning remains highly constrained.
reports._notes: Core fiscal-flow node under extreme revenue and institutional constraints.
reports._url_evidence: Central Bank of Syria 'إحصاءات مالية' (Financial Statistics) category page covering government accounts indicators, estimated budget resources, expenditures and executed budget operations, including the overall balance to GDP ratio; the Ministry of Finance site (syrianfinance.gov.sy, mof.gov.sy) is unreachable via WebFetch.
reports._cadence_evidence: CBS government-finance landing page lists only table headings (key indicators of government accounts, estimated budget resources, estimated budget payments, executed budget operations). No dates, editions or periodicity are shown. The site's periodic series named elsewhere (weekly economic report, monthly inflation report, annual business report) are not tied to this fiscal page.

reports.title: Syria–Turkey merchandise trade statistics
reports.publisher: Derived from Turkish and Syrian trade monitoring sources
reports.description: Bilateral trade with Turkey. Volumes have risen in the post-transition period; Turkey is a major source of imports and a key overland trade corridor. Multiple border crossings are active; trade growth is a leading indicator of external re-engagement.
reports._notes: Primary regional bilateral trade densification under recovery conditions.

reports.title: Drought and agricultural water-stress statistics
reports.publisher: Derived from FEWS NET and climate monitoring sources
reports.description: Statistics and framing of drought conditions and water stress. Consecutive drought years have sharply reduced rainfed cereal output and groundwater; recent improved rainfall has supported recovery but cumulative damage to water resources and productive assets persists.
reports._notes: High-centrality environmental constraint node linking agriculture and food security.
reports._url_evidence: FEWS NET Syria country page carrying the Food Security Outlook and Key Message Updates (June 2026 - January 2027), analysing drought, water scarcity and agricultural constraints with IPC phase classifications.
reports._cadence_evidence: FEWS NET Syria page lists a rotating set of dated products - Food Security Outlook (June 2026 - January 2027), Food Security Outlook Update (April - September 2026) and a single-month Key Message Update (July 2026) - i.e. one dated analysis per month across the three product types. The page states no frequency in words and no countable archive is exposed, so 12 is read off the monthly-dated product rotation.

_consolidation.json_syntax_repair_note: These batch files were not valid JSON as delivered: "releases_per_year" carried an unquoted text value (missing opening quote), e.g. `"releases_per_year": continuous",`. Repaired mechanically by re-quoting the value verbatim. No number was invented.
_consolidation.cadence_note: A non-numeric cadence text was moved off releases_per_year into _cadence_original verbatim and the numeric field omitted, per the v2 spec (omitted, never null). Needs a human/judgement pass to become a real number.

_normalisation.note: Second pass, 2026-08-18: mechanical alignment to src/lib/types.ts. Nothing researched, nothing invented. Every original value that was replaced is preserved on the record under a key prefixed with an underscore.
rules: jurisdiction_level mapped into the six-value union; the delivered string kept as _jurisdiction_level_original.
domains: format-normalised, then any tag outside the 22 approved values prefixed "proposed:" as the spec directs. No semantic merging was done — that needs your call.

relationship_type: part_of edges moved onto the child node as part_of; contains edges reversed onto the child; produced_by edges dropped (publisher is a string, not a node); related_to / complements held in _dropped as deferred. Off-union values were poisoning every PageRank score with NaN.
last_updated added as null where absent (required field, string|null).
region filled with the country name where it was null or missing.
releases_per_year: unambiguous single-word cadences resolved to numbers; ambiguous text left in _cadence_original and listed under _gaps.unresolved_cadence.
source_kind mapped to official/commercial; delivered value kept as _source_kind_original.
Non-schema keys Grok wrote (shape, notes, referenced_by, ...) renamed with a leading underscore so they are visibly not part of the schema. Nothing deleted.

2026-08-19: the 35 records resolved 'continuous-database' were given a nominal releases_per_year (250 business-day portals/feeds/query databases; 365 all-days monitoring: air quality, volcano/seismic, tropical-cyclone, disaster-event feeds), each with a cadence_note naming the convention. Original delivered value untouched in _cadence_original; evidence untouched in _cadence_evidence.

domain_semantic_pass.merged_into_existing: Synonyms folded into the 22 already-approved tags (prices→inflation, employment→labour, demography/census→population, monetary/central-bank→monetary-policy, gdp/grdp/regional-accounts→national-accounts, and so on).
domain_semantic_pass.promoted: 17 tags that had earned a slot were promoted out of proposed: and added to Domain in types.ts.
domain_semantic_pass.dropped: Geographic pseudo-tags (regional, provincial, urban, municipal, metropolitan) and batch-meta pseudo-tags (comprehensive, multi-domain, meta, indicators) were removed — geography is already carried by region and jurisdiction_level, and the meta ones describe the batch rather than the report.

url_research_pass.method: Per-country web research. A URL was accepted only when the page was actually retrieved and its content confirmed the publication. Publisher homepages, Wikipedia, news, aggregators and mirrors were rejected. Confirmations are stored on each node as _url_evidence.

grok_pass.asked: 75 items (34 with no URL, 41 with only a series-level URL)
grok_pass.result: Grok recovered 1 of the 34, independently reproduced all 41 series-level URLs, and returned the other 33 as dead for the same reasons Claude hit.

url_unreachable_or_not_published.title: Electricity generation and capacity statistics
url_unreachable_or_not_published.finding: Still not found. A successor publisher was located and retrieved this time - tde.gov.sy, the Public Establishment for Transmission and Distribution of Electricity under the Ministry of Energy - but it publishes no statistics product: its full menu is About / News / Tenders / Conferences / SEEP / Laws and Regulations / Jobs / Industrial Cities / Sustainability / Media Office / Contact, with no statistics or reports section, and the homepage's 'peak generation yesterday' and 'total production yesterday' fields both render 0 MW / 0 MWh. tde.gov.sy/sitemap.xml returns 404. peegt.gov.sy no longer resolves, nerc.gov.sy fails TLS verification, and the Central Bureau of Statistics (cbssyr.sy) times out on connect, so its Statistical Abstract electricity chapter cannot be reached.
url_unreachable_or_not_published.second_opinion: Grok searched independently and also came up empty, hitting the same blockers.

url_unreachable_or_not_published.title: Syria–Turkey merchandise trade statistics
url_unreachable_or_not_published.finding: Still not found. On the Turkish side, the Ministry of Trade's foreign-trade statistics page (https://ticaret.gov.tr/istatistikler/dis-ticaret-istatistikleri) was retrieved but hosts no country-level files - it only redirects users to TurkStat's query system, whose landing pages sit on veriportali.tuik.gov.tr and serve a JavaScript-required stub; the Ministry's Syria country page (ticaret.gov.tr/yurtdisi-teskilati/orta-dogu/suriye) returns 404, and the circulating 'Suriye Ulke Profili' PDFs are hosted by chambers of commerce (aso.org.tr, deik.org.tr), not by the Ministry. On the Syrian side, cbssyr.sy is unreachable and Syria publishes no bilateral trade product. No single official document covers this relationship as a series.
url_unreachable_or_not_published.second_opinion: Grok searched independently and also came up empty, hitting the same blockers.

_gaps.not_a_publication_moved_to_archive: 17 nodes removed from this file on 2026-08-18; full records in _archive/sy-syria-not-publications.json

cadence_research_pass.method: Each node's own verified URL was fetched and the release frequency read off the page — a stated periodicity, an advance release calendar, or a count of dated editions. Numbers carry their evidence in _cadence_evidence. Nothing was inferred from the title alone, and Grok's original text is preserved in _cadence_original.
